decisions.reason: An electrical device containing an illuminating lamp is explicit and appropriate to lighting equipment; portability is not categorically excluded.
The roughly 29.53-day return of a lunar phase is fully defined and distinguishes a lunar cycle from every calendar month.
The emotional style of lyric poetry is explicit and relevant to poetry, distinct from the form of a poem or mere enthusiasm.
A diced vegetable or fruit mixture served as salad is an exact culinary meaning; elegant arrangement or superior nutrition is not implied.
No exact plural sense or reviewed machination mapping is present; the familiar secret-plot meaning still needs recorded source evidence.
No exact source evidence supports this hyphenation and occupational meaning; a verified spelling mapping is needed before release.
Applying econometrics to macroeconomic theory and models is an explicit specialization relevant to the macroeconomics anchor; retain uncountable usage.
A large-scale economy is a complete meaning and distinguishes the object studied from the academic field macroeconomics.
The very large molecule meaning includes proteins and nucleic acids, supporting science and nutrition vocabulary without equating all macromolecules with protein.
The typographic capital-letter sense is verified but the sole business capitalization anchor likely concerns financing; the topic and intended homonym remain unresolved.
Treating badly or abusing is explicitly defined and directly supports abuse vocabulary without restricting it to legal proceedings.
A person appointed to office by mandate is an explicit administrative role; it is not a more technical synonym for the adjective mandatory.
The sole gerund entry repeats maneuvers and does not explain the intended strategic political action; preserve its evidence without releasing a circular definition.
The hand below the forearm or corresponding vertebrate part is fully described; retain formal usage and distinguish the whole hand from the palm alone.
The sales-stimulating price reduction is a precise retail meaning matching discount; do not substitute the unrelated software-format sense.
Exposing service industries to market forces is explicit and relevant to economic reform; it is not identical to transferring ownership into private hands.
The variable mixture of carbonate of lime, clay and possibly sand is a complete earth-material meaning; unrelated rope-working and animal homonyms are excluded.
A manufactured-product brand, especially of a car, is explicit; the brand need not be prestigious or expensive.
No exact sourced sense or reviewed marshal inflection mapping is available; the old logistics gloss cannot verify this spelling and meaning.
No exact joined-form entry supports the multi-lock key meaning; a source-backed spelling or phrase mapping is needed.
The joined phrase has no exact factual entry; do not infer a stable spaced-phrase identity merely from the obvious family relation.
Showing maternal instincts is an explicit adjective meaning related to maternal; the old claim of necessarily excessive protection is not retained.
A person registered on a school list or roll is fully explained; official enrollment does not necessarily mean every undergraduate status.
The verb enroll as a student is explicit and directly matches the educational sense of enroll; the person-denoting noun remains separate.
Mats as a collection of ground coverings is clear and relevant to exercise surfaces; it is not the separate picture-border meaning.
Coming to full development is a self-contained meaning supporting growth; exclude the medical pus-formation sense and population-level evolutionary claims.
The joined phrase lacks exact factual evidence or a reviewed mechanical advantage mapping; the old leverage explanation is not a source.
Replacing human or animal labour with machinery is a complete industrial-development meaning, narrower than all industrialization.
A receptor informing an organism about movement, tension or pressure is fully explained and matches the mechanical rather than chemical receptor category.
The large fruit-eating Old World bat meaning fits zoological bat study; avoid Wiktionary's overly broad suborder classification and the fitness implement homonym.
The SI mass unit equal to one million grams is explicit and relevant to metric tonnage; it is not interchangeable numerically with every regional ton.
The philosophical candidates are circular and WordNet's broad reform advocate does not verify the proposed belief in improving the world; retain uncertainty about intended scope.
A performer or composer of melodies is a complete music-study meaning; it is not limited to composition alone.
Something by which a person or event is remembered, such as a monument, is explicit and relevant to sightseeing; no obituary or legal-petition synonym is inferred.
A cargo ship is a direct self-contained meaning matching freighter; no historical-only restriction is invented.
The north-south or meridian-related adjective is precise geographical terminology; it is not confused with the separate southern-region meaning.
A salad mixture of small young leaves is explicit and appropriate to food vocabulary; gourmet status or nutritional superiority is not assumed.
The five bones between wrist and fingers are explicitly described and relevant to hand anatomy; the whole soft-tissue palm is not equated with these bones.
A metalworking craftsperson is verified but unrelated to the fitness Smith-machine anchor; matching a word fragment does not establish learning relevance.
The source fully explains a reaction exchanging parts of two compounds; restrict to academic chemistry rather than presenting it as everyday exchange or linguistic transposition.
